title: Freedom 101
description: Core rights every citizen must understand

lessons.title: What Are Your Rights?
lessons.explanation: Your rights protect you from government power.
lessons.when_applies: Any interaction with police or government
lessons.example: An officer asks you questions on the street
lessons.risk: You give up rights without knowing
lessons.action: Stay aware and assert your rights

lessons.title: Search & Seizure
lessons.explanation: Police need a legal reason or warrant to search you
lessons.example: Officer asks to search your car
lessons.script: I do not consent to searches

lessons.title: Right to Remain Silent
lessons.explanation: You do not have to answer police questions

title: Speech & Assembly
description: Your First Amendment rights in public — speaking, recording, and protesting

lessons.title: Peaceful Assembly
lessons.explanation: You may gather peacefully in traditional public forums like sidewalks and parks
lessons.when_applies: Protests, rallies, and demonstrations in public spaces
lessons.example: Joining a march on a public sidewalk
lessons.risk: Blocking traffic or entrances can turn lawful assembly into a citable offense
lessons.action: Stay on public property and keep pathways clear
lessons.script: We are assembling peacefully on public property.

lessons.title: Recording in Public
lessons.explanation: You generally may record police performing their duties in public
lessons.when_applies: Witnessing or being part of a public police encounter
lessons.example: Filming an arrest from a safe distance
lessons.risk: Interfering with the officer's work can lead to arrest even while recording lawfully
lessons.action: Record from a distance and never physically interfere
lessons.script: I am recording from a lawful distance and not interfering.

lessons.title: Dispersal Orders
lessons.explanation: Police may order a crowd to disperse when an assembly is declared unlawful
lessons.when_applies: A protest is declared an unlawful assembly
lessons.example: Officers announce everyone must leave the area
lessons.risk: Remaining after a lawful dispersal order can mean arrest
lessons.action: Note the order, leave calmly, and document what you saw
lessons.script: I am complying and leaving the area now.
